item.title: Is Ukraine losing America’s backing? On TV, Trump & Russia slam Zelensky over diesel drone strikes
item.description: The Kremlin has welcomed Donald Trump’s call for Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian diesel and civilian economic infrastructure, as Russian presidential spokesperson Dmitry Peskov accused Kyiv of attacking civilian infrastructure. Peskov also claimed Russian forces are advancing along the front lines and said Moscow expects that trend to continue. He warned that worsening instability in the Gulf is contributing to major disruption in global oil supplies, while defending Russia’s restrictions on petroleum product exports. Peskov also addressed Cuba’s BRICS ambitions, a reported drone incident near the Polish-Ukrainian border, Finland’s nuclear deterrence plans and potential roles for China and India in efforts to resolve the Ukraine conflict.

item.title: The missiles powering Houthis: Long-range arsenal puts Saudi Arabia, UAE and Red Sea in crosshairs?
item.description: The Houthis’ expanding missile and drone arsenal is emerging as a major threat to Saudi Arabia, Gulf states and Red Sea shipping. Built from decades of inherited Soviet, North Korean and Yemeni systems, and expanded with alleged Iranian support, the Houthi arsenal now includes ballistic missiles, cruise missiles, anti-ship weapons and long-range attack drones capable of striking targets across the region.
